scope: New source-verified console game decompilation and static recompilation projects. Exact repository URLs and game/project identities were checked against the live catalog SQLite database before staging.

projects.title: Ultraman Fighting Evolution 3 PS2 Static Recompilation
projects.status: Early and not playable. The maintainer reports that it boots through the IOP modules and sound driver, passes the memory-card check, renders the health-warning screen, and skips the opening movie, then stops on a black screen before the title. 3D/VU1 rendering is not yet working.
projects.summary: A static recompilation of the Japanese PS2 executable to a native Linux runner using PS2Recomp. It requires a user-supplied game disc and an x86-64 host with AVX2; the repository says it contains no game data.
projects.strategy: Static recompilation of PS2 MIPS code to C++
projects.source_available: Public GitHub source; the README requires the user to supply the original disc and states that no game data is included.

projects.title: Resident Evil: Dead Aim PS2 Decompilation (Bullseye)
projects.status: Work in progress. The README reports a byte-identical rebuild of every loadable byte in SLES_514.48, while only 40 of 1,328,837 code bytes (0.0030%) are decompiled; most game code remains included assembly.
projects.summary: A matching PS2 source reconstruction and reverse-engineering project for the PAL release. Building it requires a user-supplied game dump and PS2 toolchain; the repository does not claim a native PC or alternate-console port.
projects.source_available: Public GitHub repository with source, build configuration and progress data. GitHub repository metadata has no recognized license declaration.

projects.title: Rage Racer PlayStation Byte-Matching Decompilation
projects.game: Rage Racer (PAL SCES_006.50; USA SLUS_004.03; Japan SLPS_006.00 v1.0 and v1.1)
projects.platform: PlayStation (PAL SCES_006.50; USA SLUS_004.03; Japan SLPS_006.00 v1.0/v1.1)
projects.status: Matching is complete for the PAL executable: the README reports all 1,200 functions and 100% of code bytes matched, with a byte-identical linked executable. It says the USA and Japanese targets have complete source coverage using shared PAL C where possible and region-specific C where needed. Some translation units retain inline or hand-written assembly.
projects.summary: A source-only reconstruction of the PlayStation version of Rage Racer, with regional builds for PAL, USA and Japan. The project uses the original PSYQ-era toolchain to produce matching executables and requires users to supply their own game copies and toolchain.
projects.source_available: Public source-only repository; the README says game images, extracted assets, SDK files and compiler binaries are not included. GitHub license detection returns NOASSERTION, so the source license is unclear.

projects.title: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike PS2 Decompilation
projects.game: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike (PlayStation 2 version; revision unspecified)
projects.status: The maintainer README says the PS2 game code is fully decompiled. CRI middleware is partly decompiled, with most filesystem and sound functions matching.
projects.summary: A PS2 source reconstruction project intended to support preservation, study and later ports. Its README links build and decompilation guides but does not claim a native build for another platform.
projects.source_available: Public GitHub source repository with build and decompilation documentation.
